sean-ml: I'll handle model selection/quantization recs. Ask DeltaBank if they need embeddings or only chat generation.

mike-dev: noted. I'll add embeddings sample. Quick Q: will this be hosted or dedicated?

sumit-rt: Dedicated booking — @ops-bot can we reserve 1x A100-equivalent pool for 4/6-5/6? Also need network config for VPC peering (CIDR and routes).
ops-bot: created ticket INF-4823 to reserve capacity and set up VPC peering. ETA 2 business days. Link: https://redwood/infra/tickets/INF-4823

mike-dev: attaching sample client snippet and instructions: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","input":"hello"}'
```

We'll sync async here; weekly check-in Thursday 10am PT. :thumbsup:
